OnePlus Restructures, Exits US and Europe Markets

OnePlus is reportedly planning to exit the US and European markets as part of a significant restructuring of its smartphone business, driven by parent company Oppo. This move is expected to reshape the company's global operations. The exact timeline and full implications of this restructuring are still emerging.
